description: Validated mortality observations and life-table rates. This schema is a backward-compatible extension of V1.

rate_contract.deaths_per_100000_exposure: calculated_rate = deaths / exposure * 100000; exposure_unit must be explicit
rate_contract.m_x: rate_value is a central death rate per person-year and must be >=0
rate_contract.life_table_mx_qx: mx >=0 and qx in [0,1]; preserve both source values

provenance_contract: retrieved_at must include date/time or date
data_status distinguishes observed, estimated, projected or modelled data
non_inference_rules: Do not convert q_x to m_x or vice versa without an explicit life-table method
Do not infer actual deaths/exposure from a probability-only source
Do not treat hypothetical life-table cohort counts as observed population counts
This sidecar does not feed H1/H2 or alter canonical patterns
